verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a voice-agent framework with a CLI and cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a batch or bulk capability, such as acting on many sessions, agents or deployments in one operation. The nearest items are parallel fan-out between subagents and unlimited cloud concurrency, which are related but different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
